Recognition of a component of epithelioid histiocytes and Touton giant cells, and coexpression of ALK and histiocytic markers, suggests APH rather than IMT.
EFH is a localized cutaneous tumor that is more circumscribed, surrounded by epidermal collarettes, and negative for CD68, S-100, and PU.1.
It may not be expressed in a portion of HS.
Regarding HS, immunohistochemistry of cytokeratin and CD3, CD20, and CD30 may also be necessary to exclude carcinoma or lymphoma.
